name: 23.QF4

origin.summary: Test 4 of the 2023 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: A 20-minute AMRAP of a long row, GHD sit-ups, a shorter row, and v-ups.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/quarterfinalsindividual/2023/4 (official CrossFit Games Individual Quarterfinals workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
